motivation.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
motivation.author: Steve Jobs

motivation.text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
motivation.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivation.text: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
motivation.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

motivation.text: Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
motivation.author: Sam Levenson

motivation.text: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
motivation.author: George Addair

motivation.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
motivation.author: Confucius

motivation.text: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become.
motivation.author: Zig Ziglar

motivation.text: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
motivation.author: William James

motivation.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
motivation.author: Mark Twain

motivation.text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
motivation.author: Winston Churchill

wisdom.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
wisdom.author: Socrates

wisdom.text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
wisdom.author: Albert Einstein

wisdom.text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

wisdom.text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
wisdom.author: Socrates

wisdom.text: It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

wisdom.text: To understand everything is to forgive everything.
wisdom.author: Buddha

wisdom.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
wisdom.author: Lao Tzu

wisdom.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

wisdom.text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
wisdom.author: Buddha

humor.text: I'm on a whiskey diet. I've lost three days already.
humor.author: Tommy Cooper

humor.text: Behind every great man is a woman rolling her eyes.
humor.author: Jim Carrey

humor.text: I'm not arguing, I'm just explaining why I'm right.
If at first you don't succeed, then skydiving definitely isn't for you.
humor.author: Steven Wright

humor.text: Age is of no importance unless you're a cheese.
humor.author: Luis Buñuel

humor.text: I find television very educating. Every time somebody turns on the set, I go into the other room and read a book.
humor.author: Groucho Marx

humor.text: Never go to a doctor whose office plants have died.
humor.author: Erma Bombeck

humor.text: My favorite machine at the gym is the vending machine.
I'm not lazy, I'm on energy-saving mode.
A balanced diet is a cookie in each hand.

life.text: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
life.author: John Lennon

life.text: Get busy living or get busy dying.
life.author: Stephen King

life.text: In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
life.author: Abraham Lincoln

life.text: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
life.author: Dalai Lama

life.text: Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away.
life.author: Maya Angelou

life.text: Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
life.author: Mark Twain

life.text: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
life.author: Mahatma Gandhi

life.text: The only impossible journey is the one you never begin.
life.author: Tony Robbins

life.text: Not how long, but how well you have lived is the main thing.
life.author: Seneca

life.text: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
life.author: Oscar Wilde

success.text: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
success.author: Walt Disney

success.text: Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
success.author: Winston Churchill

success.text: Opportunities don't happen. You create them.
success.author: Chris Grosser

success.text: Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
success.author: John D. Rockefeller

success.text: I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.
success.author: Thomas Jefferson

success.text: The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
success.author: Bruce Lee

success.text: If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.
success.author: Steve Jobs

success.text: There is no substitute for hard work.
success.author: Thomas Edison

success.text: Dream big. Work hard. Stay focused.
Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
success.author: Henry David Thoreau
